124	func cmdMatrix(args []string) int {
125		fs := flagSet("matrix")
126		workDir := fs.String("work-dir", "", "Repository root (default: cwd)")
127		subset := fs.String("subset", "", "TerminalBench subset manifest (default: scripts/beadbench/external/termbench-subset-canary.json)")
128		profilesCSV := fs.String("profiles", "", "Comma-separated benchmark profile ids")
129		harnessesCSV := fs.String("harnesses", "fiz,pi,opencode", "Comma-separated harness adapter names")
130		reps := fs.Int("reps", 3, "Repetitions per harness/profile/task")
131		budgetUSD := fs.Float64("budget-usd", 0, "Matrix budget in USD (0 = no cap)")
132		out := fs.String("out", "", "Output directory (default: benchmark-results/matrix-<timestamp> under work-dir)")
133		resume := fs.Bool("resume", false, "Skip terminal reports already present under --out")
134		forceRerun := fs.Bool("force-rerun", false, "Rerun every tuple even when a terminal report exists")
135		retryBudgetHalted := fs.Bool("retry-budget-halted", false, "Rerun budget_halted reports while resuming")
136		perRunBudgetUSD := fs.Float64("per-run-budget-usd", 0, "Per-run budget cap in USD (0 = no per-run cap)")
137		tasksDir := fs.String("tasks-dir", "", "Path to TB-2 tasks directory; when set, harbor run is used for grading")
138		jobs := fs.Int("jobs", 1, "Number of tuple runs to execute concurrently (default: 1)")
139		if err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {
140			return 2
141		}
142		if *reps <= 0 {
143			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --reps must be > 0\n", benchCommandName())
144			return 2
145		}
146		if *profilesCSV == "" {
147			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --profiles is required\n", benchCommandName())
148			return 2
149		}
150		if *harnessesCSV == "" {
151			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --harnesses is required\n", benchCommandName())
152			return 2
153		}
154	
155		wd := resolveWorkDir(*workDir)
156		subsetPath := *subset
157		if subsetPath == "" {
158			subsetPath = filepath.Join(wd, defaultMatrixSubset)
159		} else if !filepath.IsAbs(subsetPath) {
160			subsetPath = filepath.Join(wd, subsetPath)
161		}
162		outDir := *out
163		if outDir == "" {
164			outDir = filepath.Join(wd, "benchmark-results", "matrix-"+time.Now().UTC().Format("20060102T150405Z"))
165		} else if !filepath.IsAbs(outDir) {
166			outDir = filepath.Join(wd, outDir)
167		}
168	
169		profileIDs := splitCSV(*profilesCSV)
170		harnesses := splitCSV(*harnessesCSV)
171		if len(profileIDs) == 0 || len(harnesses) == 0 {
172			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --profiles and --harnesses must not be empty\n", benchCommandName())
173			return 2
174		}
175	
176		subsetData, err := loadTermbenchSubset(subsetPath)
177		if err != nil {
178			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: load subset %s: %v\n", benchCommandName(), subsetPath, err)
179			return 1
180		}
181		profiles, err := selectMatrixProfiles(wd, profileIDs)
182		if err != nil {
183			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
184			return 1
185		}
186		if err := os.MkdirAll(outDir, 0o750); err != nil {
187			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: create output dir: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
188			return 1
189		}
190	
191		// Resolve harbor binary if tasks-dir is set (enables graded runs via Docker).
192		resolvedTasksDir := *tasksDir
193		if resolvedTasksDir != "" && !filepath.IsAbs(resolvedTasksDir) {
194			resolvedTasksDir = filepath.Join(wd, resolvedTasksDir)
195		}
196		harborBin := ""
197		if resolvedTasksDir != "" {
198			if bin, err := exec.LookPath("harbor"); err == nil {
199				harborBin = bin
200			} else {
201				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: --tasks-dir set but harbor not found on PATH\n", benchCommandName())
202				return 1
203			}
204		}
205	
206		// Build the full list of tuples to run.
207		type tupleSpec struct {
208			harness string
209			prof    *profile.Profile
210			rep     int
211			task    termbenchSubsetEntry
212		}
213		var tuples []tupleSpec
214		for _, harness := range harnesses {
215			for _, prof := range profiles {
216				for rep := 1; rep <= *reps; rep++ {
217					for _, task := range subsetData.Tasks {
218						tuples = append(tuples, tupleSpec{harness, prof, rep, task})
219					}
220				}
221			}
222		}
223	
224		concurrency := *jobs
225		if concurrency < 1 {
226			concurrency = 1
227		}
228	
229		type tupleResult struct {
230			report  matrixRunReport
231			skipped bool
232			err     error
233		}
234	
235		results := make([]tupleResult, len(tuples))
236		sem := make(chan struct{}, concurrency)
237	
238		var (
239			mu              sync.Mutex
240			accumulatedCost float64
241			firstErr        error
242		)
243	
244		var wg sync.WaitGroup
245		for i, spec := range tuples {
246			wg.Add(1)
247			go func(i int, spec tupleSpec) {
248				defer wg.Done()
249				sem <- struct{}{}
250				defer func() { <-sem }()
251	
252				mu.Lock()
253				cost := accumulatedCost
254				mu.Unlock()
255	
256				report, skipped, err := runMatrixTuple(matrixTupleOptions{
257					workDir:           wd,
258					outDir:            outDir,
259					harness:           spec.harness,
260					profile:           spec.prof,
261					rep:               spec.rep,
262					task:              spec.task,
263					budgetUSD:         *budgetUSD,
264					perRunBudgetUSD:   *perRunBudgetUSD,
265					accumulatedCost:   cost,
266					resume:            *resume,
267					forceRerun:        *forceRerun,
268					retryBudgetHalted: *retryBudgetHalted,
269					tasksDir:          resolvedTasksDir,
270					harborBin:         harborBin,
271				})
272	
273				mu.Lock()
274				results[i] = tupleResult{report, skipped, err}
275				if err != nil && firstErr == nil {
276					firstErr = err
277				}
278				if err == nil && !skipped {
279					accumulatedCost += report.CostUSD
280				}
281				mu.Unlock()
282			}(i, spec)
283		}
284		wg.Wait()
285	
286		if firstErr != nil {
287			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: %v\n", benchCommandName(), firstErr)
288			return 1
289		}
290	
291		var runs []matrixRunReport
292		for _, r := range results {
293			runs = append(runs, r.report)
294		}
295	
296		sort.Slice(runs, func(i, j int) bool {
297			return matrixRunKey(runs[i]) < matrixRunKey(runs[j])
298		})
299		output := matrixOutput{
300			GeneratedAt:     time.Now().UTC(),
301			SubsetPath:      subsetPath,
302			Profiles:        profileIDs,
303			Harnesses:       harnesses,
304			Reps:            *reps,
305			BudgetUSD:       *budgetUSD,
306			PerRunBudgetUSD: *perRunBudgetUSD,
307			Runs:            runs,
308			Cells:           summarizeMatrixCells(runs),
309			Notes: []string{
310				fmt.Sprintf("concurrency: --jobs %d", concurrency),
311				"adapter_module records the Python adapter path passed by the runner for the harness cell.",
312			},
313		}
314		matrixPath := filepath.Join(outDir, "matrix.json")
315		if err := writeJSONAtomic(matrixPath, output); err != nil {
316			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s matrix: write matrix.json: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
317			return 1
318		}
319		fmt.Printf("matrix results: %s\n", matrixPath)
320		return 0
321	}

340	func runMatrixTuple(opts matrixTupleOptions) (matrixRunReport, bool, error) {
341		cellDir := matrixTupleDir(opts.outDir, opts.harness, opts.profile.ID, opts.rep, opts.task.ID)
342		reportPath := filepath.Join(cellDir, matrixReportName)
343		if !opts.forceRerun {
344			if existing, ok, err := loadExistingMatrixReport(reportPath); err != nil {
345				return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
346			} else if ok && shouldSkipMatrixReport(existing, opts.resume, opts.retryBudgetHalted) {
347				return existing, true, nil
348			}
349		}
350	
351		release, err := acquireMatrixLock(filepath.Join(cellDir, matrixLockName))
352		if err != nil {
353			return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
354		}
355		defer release()
356	
357		started := time.Now().UTC()
358		report := matrixRunReport{
359			Harness:         opts.harness,
360			ProfileID:       opts.profile.ID,
361			ProfilePath:     opts.profile.Path,
362			ProfileSnapshot: opts.profile.Versioning.Snapshot,
363			AdapterModule:   matrixAdapterModule(opts.harness),
364			HarborAgent:     filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("scripts", "benchmark", "harness_adapters", moduleFileName(opts.harness))) + ":Agent",
365			Rep:             opts.rep,
366			TaskID:          opts.task.ID,
367			Category:        opts.task.Category,
368			Difficulty:      opts.task.Difficulty,
369			OutputDir:       cellDir,
370			StartedAt:       started,
371			PricingSource:   profilePricingSource(opts.profile),
372			SamplingUsed:    samplingUsedFromProfile(opts.profile),
373			ModelServerInfo: queryModelServerInfo(opts.profile),
374		}
375	
376		if opts.budgetUSD > 0 && opts.accumulatedCost >= opts.budgetUSD {
377			report.ProcessOutcome = "budget_halted"
378			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
379			report.FinalStatus = deriveMatrixFinalStatus(report.ProcessOutcome, report.GradingOutcome, report.Reward, false)
380			report.FinishedAt = time.Now().UTC()
381			if err := writeJSONAtomic(reportPath, report); err != nil {
382				return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
383			}
384			return report, false, nil
385		}
386	
387		workDir := filepath.Join(cellDir, "work")
388		if err := os.MkdirAll(workDir, 0o750); err != nil {
389			return matrixRunReport{}, false, fmt.Errorf("create tuple workdir: %w", err)
390		}
391	
392		if opts.harborBin != "" {
393			taskPath := filepath.Join(opts.tasksDir, opts.task.ID)
394			if _, err := os.Stat(taskPath); err != nil {
395				report.ProcessOutcome = "install_fail_permanent"
396				report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
397				report.Error = fmt.Sprintf("task directory not found: %s", taskPath)
398			} else {
399				harborResult, err := runMatrixHarbor(harborRunOpts{
400					harborBin: opts.harborBin,
401					taskPath:  taskPath,
402					harness:   opts.harness,
403					profile:   opts.profile,
404					jobsDir:   cellDir,
405					jobName:   fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-rep%d", opts.harness, opts.task.ID, opts.rep),
406					repoRoot:  opts.workDir,
407				})
408				if err != nil {
409					report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
410					report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
411					report.Error = err.Error()
412				} else {
413					report.ExitCode = harborResult.exitCode
414					report.Error = harborResult.errText
415					seconds := harborResult.wallSeconds
416					report.WallSeconds = &seconds
417					if harborResult.reward != nil {
418						report.Reward = harborResult.reward
419						report.GradingOutcome = "graded"
420						report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
421					} else if harborResult.exitCode != 0 {
422						report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
423						report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
424					} else {
425						report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
426						report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
427					}
428				}
429			}
430		} else {
431			result, err := runMatrixAdapter(opts.workDir, report.AdapterModule, opts.profile, matrixPrompt(opts.task), opts.task.ID, workDir)
432			if err != nil {
433				report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
434				report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
435				report.Error = err.Error()
436			} else {
437				report.Command = result.Command.Argv
438				report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Apply.Notes...)
439				report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Command.Notes...)
440				report.ExitCode = result.ExitCode
441				if result.ExitCode != 0 {
442					report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
443					report.Error = strings.TrimSpace(result.Stderr)
444				}
445				applyTelemetry(&report, result.Telemetry)
446				if report.WallSeconds == nil && result.Duration >= 0 {
447					seconds := float64(result.Duration) / 1000
448					report.WallSeconds = &seconds
449				}
450			}
451		}
452		if report.ProcessOutcome == "" {
453			report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
454		}
455		if report.GradingOutcome == "" {
456			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
457		}
458		if report.Reward != nil && report.GradingOutcome == "ungraded" {
459			report.GradingOutcome = "graded"
460		}
461		report.CostUSD = matrixCostUSD(opts.profile, report)
462		if (opts.perRunBudgetUSD > 0 && report.CostUSD > opts.perRunBudgetUSD) ||
463			(opts.budgetUSD > 0 && opts.accumulatedCost+report.CostUSD > opts.budgetUSD) {
464			report.ProcessOutcome = "budget_halted"
465			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
466			report.Reward = nil
467		}
468		report.FinalStatus = deriveMatrixFinalStatus(report.ProcessOutcome, report.GradingOutcome, report.Reward, report.Retriable)
469		report.InvalidClass = classifyMatrixInvalid(report)
470		report.FinishedAt = time.Now().UTC()
471		if err := writeJSONAtomic(reportPath, report); err != nil {
472			return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
473		}
474		return report, false, nil
475	}

787	func acquireMatrixLock(path string) (func(), error) {
788		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o750); err != nil {
789			return nil, err
790		}
791		lock := matrixLock{PID: os.Getpid(), StartedAt: time.Now().UTC()}
792		raw, _ := json.Marshal(lock)
793		for attempts := 0; attempts < 2; attempts++ {
794			f, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600) // #nosec G304 -- path is the matrix lock file path
795			if err == nil {
796				if _, werr := f.Write(raw); werr != nil {
797					_ = f.Close()
798					_ = os.Remove(path)
799					return nil, werr
800				}
801				if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
802					_ = os.Remove(path)
803					return nil, err
804				}
805				return func() { _ = os.Remove(path) }, nil
806			}
807			if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist) {
808				return nil, err
809			}
810			existing, readErr := readMatrixLock(path)
811			if readErr == nil && !processAlive(existing.PID) {
812				if removeErr := os.Remove(path); removeErr != nil && !errors.Is(removeErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
813					return nil, fmt.Errorf("remove stale lock %s: %w", path, removeErr)
814				}
815				continue
816			}
817			pid := "unknown"
818			if readErr == nil && existing.PID > 0 {
819				pid = strconv.Itoa(existing.PID)
820			}
821			return nil, fmt.Errorf("matrix tuple locked by pid %s: %s", pid, path)
822		}
823		return nil, fmt.Errorf("could not acquire matrix tuple lock: %s", path)
824	}

1135	// /api/v0/models/<id> endpoint. Returns nil if the server is not lmstudio
1136	// or the request fails.
1137	func queryModelServerInfo(p *profile.Profile) *profile.ModelServerInfo {
1138		base := strings.TrimRight(p.Provider.BaseURL, "/")
1139		// Only try lmstudio-style endpoints (port 1234 conventional, or path /api/v0 present).
1140		if !strings.Contains(base, ":1234") && !strings.Contains(base, "/api/v0") {
1141			return nil
1142		}
1143		// Strip trailing /v1 to get the base server URL.
1144		apiBase := strings.TrimSuffix(base, "/v1")
1145		modelID := p.Provider.Model
1146		url := apiBase + "/api/v0/models/" + modelID
1147	
1148		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
1149		defer cancel()
1150		req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, url, nil)
1151		if err != nil {
1152			return nil
1153		}
1154		resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
1155		if err != nil || resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
1156			return nil
1157		}
1158		defer resp.Body.Close()
1159		var info struct {
1160			Quantization        string `json:"quantization"`
1161			LoadedContextLength int    `json:"loaded_context_length"`
1162			MaxContextLength    int    `json:"max_context_length"`
1163		}
1164		if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&info); err != nil {
1165			return nil
1166		}
1167		return &profile.ModelServerInfo{
1168			Quantization:        info.Quantization,
1169			LoadedContextLength: info.LoadedContextLength,
1170			MaxContextLength:    info.MaxContextLength,
1171			Source:              url,
1172		}
1173	}

15	// cmdReport implements the 'report' subcommand.
16	func cmdReport(args []string) int {
17		fs := flagSet("report")
18		resultsDir := fs.String("results-dir", "", "Directory containing result JSON files (default: bench/results relative to cwd)")
19		format := fs.String("format", "table", "Output format: table|json|markdown")
20		workDir := fs.String("work-dir", "", "Agent working directory (default: cwd)")
21		if err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {
22			return 2
23		}
24	
25		wd := resolveWorkDir(*workDir)
26	
27		dir := *resultsDir
28		if dir == "" {
29			dir = filepath.Join(wd, "bench", "results")
30		}
31	
32		// Collect all bench-*.json files.
33		entries, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(dir, "bench-*.json"))
34		if err != nil || len(entries) == 0 {
35			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s report: no result files found in %s\n", benchCommandName(), dir)
36			return 1
37		}
38	
39		// Sort descending — newest first.
40		sort.Sort(sort.Reverse(sort.StringSlice(entries)))
41	
42		// Load the most recent result by default.
43		path := entries[0]
44		data, err := safefs.ReadFile(path)
45		if err != nil {
46			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s report: read %s: %v\n", benchCommandName(), path, err)
47			return 1
48		}
49	
50		var result comparison.BenchmarkResult
51		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &result); err != nil {
52			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s report: parse %s: %v\n", benchCommandName(), path, err)
53			return 1
54		}
55	
56		switch *format {
57		case "json":
58			out, _ := json.MarshalIndent(result, "", "  ")
59			fmt.Println(string(out))
60		case "markdown":
61			printMarkdownReport(&result)
62		default:
63			printSummaryTable(&result)
64		}
65	
66		return 0
67	}

69	// printSummaryTable renders a human-readable table to stdout.
70	func printSummaryTable(result *comparison.BenchmarkResult) {
71		fmt.Printf("Benchmark: %s  version: %s  at: %s\n\n",
72			result.Suite, result.Version, result.Timestamp.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05Z"))
73	
74		fmt.Printf("%-40s %8s %8s %12s %12s %12s\n",
75			"ARM", "OK", "FAIL", "TOK", "COST_USD", "AVG_MS")
76		fmt.Printf("%-40s %8s %8s %12s %12s %12s\n",
77			strings.Repeat("-", 40), "-------", "-------",
78			"-----------", "-----------", "-----------")
79		for _, arm := range result.Summary.Arms {
80			fmt.Printf("%-40s %8d %8d %12d %12.6f %12d\n",
81				truncate(arm.Label, 40),
82				arm.Completed, arm.Failed,
83				arm.TotalTokens,
84				arm.TotalCostUSD,
85				arm.AvgDurationMS,
86			)
87		}
88		fmt.Printf("\nTotal prompts: %d\n", result.Summary.TotalPrompts)
89	
90		printCostCapSkips(result)
91		printParityMatrix(result)
92	}
93	
94	// printCostCapSkips lists any tasks that were skipped due to cost cap.
95	func printCostCapSkips(result *comparison.BenchmarkResult) {
96		type skip struct {
97			prompt string
98			arm    string
99		}
100		var skips []skip
101		for _, cmp := range result.Comparisons {
102			for _, arm := range cmp.Arms {
103				if arm.Error == CostCapSkipReason {
104					skips = append(skips, skip{prompt: cmp.ID, arm: arm.Harness})
105				}
106			}
107		}
108		if len(skips) == 0 {
109			return
110		}
111		fmt.Printf("\n--- Cost cap skips (%d) ---\n", len(skips))
112		for _, s := range skips {
113			fmt.Printf("  skipped: prompt=%s  arm=%s\n", s.prompt, s.arm)
114		}
115	}
116	
117	// printParityMatrix prints a per-task parity comparison between all arm pairs.
118	func printParityMatrix(result *comparison.BenchmarkResult) {
119		if len(result.Arms) < 2 || len(result.Comparisons) == 0 {
120			return
121		}
122	
123		// Build arm labels slice.
124		labels := make([]string, len(result.Arms))
125		for i, a := range result.Arms {
126			labels[i] = a.Label
127		}
128	
129		fmt.Printf("\n--- Parity matrix (tool-call sequence equality / output similarity) ---\n")
130		fmt.Printf("%-20s  %-30s  %-30s  %8s  %10s\n", "PROMPT", "ARM_A", "ARM_B", "TC_EQUAL", "OUT_SIM")
131		fmt.Printf("%-20s  %-30s  %-30s  %8s  %10s\n",
132			strings.Repeat("-", 20), strings.Repeat("-", 30), strings.Repeat("-", 30), "--------", "----------")
133	
134		for _, cmp := range result.Comparisons {
135			cells := BuildParityMatrix(cmp, labels)
136			for _, cell := range cells {
137				eq := "NO"
138				if cell.ToolSeqEqual {
139					eq = "YES"
140				}
141				fmt.Printf("%-20s  %-30s  %-30s  %8s  %10.3f\n",
142					truncate(cmp.ID, 20),
143					truncate(cell.ArmA, 30),
144					truncate(cell.ArmB, 30),
145					eq,
146					cell.OutputSimilarity,
147				)
148			}
149		}

393			taskPath := filepath.Join(opts.tasksDir, opts.task.ID)
394			if _, err := os.Stat(taskPath); err != nil {
395				report.ProcessOutcome = "install_fail_permanent"
396				report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
397				report.Error = fmt.Sprintf("task directory not found: %s", taskPath)
398			} else {
399				harborResult, err := runMatrixHarbor(harborRunOpts{
400					harborBin: opts.harborBin,
401					taskPath:  taskPath,
402					harness:   opts.harness,
403					profile:   opts.profile,
404					jobsDir:   cellDir,
405					jobName:   fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-rep%d", opts.harness, opts.task.ID, opts.rep),
406					repoRoot:  opts.workDir,
407				})
408				if err != nil {
409					report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
410					report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
411					report.Error = err.Error()
412				} else {
413					report.ExitCode = harborResult.exitCode
414					report.Error = harborResult.errText
415					seconds := harborResult.wallSeconds
416					report.WallSeconds = &seconds
417					if harborResult.reward != nil {
418						report.Reward = harborResult.reward
419						report.GradingOutcome = "graded"
420						report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
421					} else if harborResult.exitCode != 0 {
422						report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
423						report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
424					} else {
425						report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
426						report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
427					}
428				}
429			}
430		} else {
431			result, err := runMatrixAdapter(opts.workDir, report.AdapterModule, opts.profile, matrixPrompt(opts.task), opts.task.ID, workDir)
432			if err != nil {
433				report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
434				report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
435				report.Error = err.Error()
436			} else {
437				report.Command = result.Command.Argv
438				report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Apply.Notes...)
439				report.AdapterTranslationNotes = append(report.AdapterTranslationNotes, result.Command.Notes...)
440				report.ExitCode = result.ExitCode
441				if result.ExitCode != 0 {
442					report.ProcessOutcome = "harness_crash"
443					report.Error = strings.TrimSpace(result.Stderr)
444				}
445				applyTelemetry(&report, result.Telemetry)
446				if report.WallSeconds == nil && result.Duration >= 0 {
447					seconds := float64(result.Duration) / 1000
448					report.WallSeconds = &seconds
449				}
450			}
451		}
452		if report.ProcessOutcome == "" {
453			report.ProcessOutcome = "completed"
454		}
455		if report.GradingOutcome == "" {
456			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
457		}
458		if report.Reward != nil && report.GradingOutcome == "ungraded" {
459			report.GradingOutcome = "graded"
460		}
461		report.CostUSD = matrixCostUSD(opts.profile, report)
462		if (opts.perRunBudgetUSD > 0 && report.CostUSD > opts.perRunBudgetUSD) ||
463			(opts.budgetUSD > 0 && opts.accumulatedCost+report.CostUSD > opts.budgetUSD) {
464			report.ProcessOutcome = "budget_halted"
465			report.GradingOutcome = "ungraded"
466			report.Reward = nil
467		}
468		report.FinalStatus = deriveMatrixFinalStatus(report.ProcessOutcome, report.GradingOutcome, report.Reward, report.Retriable)
469		report.InvalidClass = classifyMatrixInvalid(report)
470		report.FinishedAt = time.Now().UTC()
471		if err := writeJSONAtomic(reportPath, report); err != nil {
472			return matrixRunReport{}, false, err
473		}
474		return report, false, nil
475	}

529			args = append(args, "--agent-timeout-multiplier", multiplier)
530		}
531		if apiKeyVal != "" {
532			args = append(args, "--ae", apiKeyEnv+"="+apiKeyVal)
533		}
534		// Pass provider config so Harbor agents can configure the model endpoint.
535		args = append(args,
536			"--ae", "FIZEAU_BASE_URL="+opts.profile.Provider.BaseURL,
537			"--ae", "FIZEAU_MODEL="+opts.profile.Provider.Model,
538			"--ae", "FIZEAU_PROVIDER="+fizeauProviderEnv(opts.profile),
539		)
540		if apiKeyVal != "" {
541			args = append(args, "--ae", "FIZEAU_API_KEY="+apiKeyVal)
542		}
543		// Forward sampling params so fiz reads them via FIZEAU_* env overrides.
544		for _, kv := range samplingEnvPairs(opts.profile) {
545			args = append(args, "--ae", kv)
546		}
547	
548		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 35*time.Minute)
549		defer cancel()
550		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, opts.harborBin, args...) // #nosec G204 G702 -- harborBin is a validated binary path from config
551		// Add repo root to PYTHONPATH so harbor_adapters modules resolve.
552		env := os.Environ()
553		pythonPath := opts.repoRoot
554		for i, e := range env {
555			if strings.HasPrefix(e, "PYTHONPATH=") {
556				pythonPath = opts.repoRoot + string(os.PathListSeparator) + e[len("PYTHONPATH="):]
557				env[i] = "PYTHONPATH=" + pythonPath
558				pythonPath = ""
559				break
560			}
561		}
562		if pythonPath != "" {
563			env = append(env, "PYTHONPATH="+pythonPath)
564		}
565		cmd.Env = env
566		cmd.Dir = opts.repoRoot
567	
568		var combined bytes.Buffer
569		cmd.Stdout = &combined
570		cmd.Stderr = &combined
571		runErr := cmd.Run()
572		wall := time.Since(started).Seconds()
573	
574		exitCode := 0
575		if runErr != nil {
576			var ee *exec.ExitError
577			if errors.As(runErr, &ee) {
578				exitCode = ee.ExitCode()
579			} else {
580				return harborRunResult{}, runErr
581			}
582		}
583	
584		// Find reward.txt written by the Harbor verifier.
585		var reward *int
586		jobOutDir := filepath.Join(opts.jobsDir, opts.jobName)
587		entries, _ := os.ReadDir(jobOutDir)
588		for _, e := range entries {
589			rewardFile := filepath.Join(jobOutDir, e.Name(), "verifier", "reward.txt")
590			data, err := os.ReadFile(rewardFile) // #nosec G304 -- rewardFile is under runner-owned output dir
591			if err == nil {
592				val, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(string(data)))
593				if err == nil {
594					reward = &val
595				}
596				break
597			}
598		}
599	
600		errText := ""
601		if exitCode != 0 || reward == nil {
602			errText = strings.TrimSpace(combined.String())
603			if len(errText) > 2000 {
604				errText = errText[:2000]
605			}
606		}
607		return harborRunResult{
608			reward:      reward,
609			exitCode:    exitCode,
610			wallSeconds: wall,
611			errText:     errText,
612		}, nil
613	}

787	func acquireMatrixLock(path string) (func(), error) {
788		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o750); err != nil {
789			return nil, err
790		}
791		lock := matrixLock{PID: os.Getpid(), StartedAt: time.Now().UTC()}
792		raw, _ := json.Marshal(lock)
793		for attempts := 0; attempts < 2; attempts++ {
794			f, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600) // #nosec G304 -- path is the matrix lock file path
795			if err == nil {
796				if _, werr := f.Write(raw); werr != nil {
797					_ = f.Close()
798					_ = os.Remove(path)
799					return nil, werr
800				}
801				if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
802					_ = os.Remove(path)
803					return nil, err
804				}
805				return func() { _ = os.Remove(path) }, nil
806			}
807			if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist) {
808				return nil, err
809			}
810			existing, readErr := readMatrixLock(path)
811			if readErr == nil && !processAlive(existing.PID) {
812				if removeErr := os.Remove(path); removeErr != nil && !errors.Is(removeErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
813					return nil, fmt.Errorf("remove stale lock %s: %w", path, removeErr)
814				}
815				continue
816			}
817			pid := "unknown"
818			if readErr == nil && existing.PID > 0 {
819				pid = strconv.Itoa(existing.PID)
820			}
821			return nil, fmt.Errorf("matrix tuple locked by pid %s: %s", pid, path)
822		}
823		return nil, fmt.Errorf("could not acquire matrix tuple lock: %s", path)
824	}

898		case "install_failed":

904			return processOutcome

907			if *reward == 1 {
908				return "graded_pass"
909			}
910			return "graded_fail"
911		}
912		if processOutcome == "completed" && gradingOutcome == "ungraded" {
913			return "ran"
914		}
915		if processOutcome != "" {
916			return processOutcome
917		}

931		type acc struct {
932			cell          matrixCell
933			rewards       []float64
934			invalidCounts map[string]int
935			cost          float64
936			inputTokens   int
937			outputTokens  int
938			cachedTokens  int
939			retriedTokens int
940		}
941		byKey := map[string]*acc{}
942		for _, run := range runs {
943			key := run.Harness + "\x00" + run.ProfileID
944			a := byKey[key]
945			if a == nil {
946				a = &acc{cell: matrixCell{Harness: run.Harness, ProfileID: run.ProfileID}}
947				byKey[key] = a
948			}
949			a.cell.NRuns++
950			if invalidClass := classifyMatrixInvalid(run); invalidClass != "" {
951				a.cell.NInvalid++
952				if a.invalidCounts == nil {
953					a.invalidCounts = map[string]int{}
954				}
955				a.invalidCounts[invalidClass]++
956			} else {
957				a.cell.NValid++
958				if run.Reward != nil {
959					a.cell.NReported++
960					a.rewards = append(a.rewards, float64(*run.Reward))
961				}
962			}
963			a.cost += run.CostUSD
964			a.inputTokens += intValue(run.InputTokens)
965			a.outputTokens += intValue(run.OutputTokens)
966			a.cachedTokens += intValue(run.CachedInputTokens)
967			a.retriedTokens += intValue(run.RetriedInputTokens)
968		}
969		cells := make([]matrixCell, 0, len(byKey))
970		for _, a := range byKey {
971			a.cell.CostUSD = a.cost

67	// runExternalTermbench is the cmd/bench entry point for `--external=termbench`.
68	// It is invoked from cmdRun when the flag is set; see runner.go.
69	//
70	// What it does:
71	//
72	//  1. Loads the frozen subset manifest (default
73	//     scripts/beadbench/external/termbench-subset.json).
74	//  2. For each entry, locates the upstream task directory under
75	//     scripts/benchmark/external/terminal-bench(-2)/tasks/<id>/.
76	//  3. Builds an ExecutionPlan and feeds it to fizeau.Service.Execute.
77	//  4. Captures harness events into ATIF v1.4 trajectory and writes
78	//     them to benchmark-results/termbench/<run-id>/<task>/logs/agent/.
79	//  5. Reads any verifier output (reward.txt) the upstream grader has
80	//     placed in the same directory and folds the verdict into the
81	//     report. We do NOT run the grader ourselves — running pytest in
82	//     the task's Docker image is upstream's responsibility (see SD-008).
83	//
84	// On a clean machine with no Docker stack, runs will complete with
85	// status=ran and no reward — that is the honest outcome the bead
86	// describes ("don't fake passing tests").
87	func runExternalTermbench(opts externalRunOptions) int {
88		tasksDir := opts.tasksDir
89		if tasksDir == "" {
90			// terminal-bench-2 layout: task directories live at the repo
91			// root (each task is a top-level directory), not under tasks/.
92			// SD-008 §1 records this. The legacy TB1 path is also probed.
93			candidates := []string{
94				filepath.Join(opts.workDir, "scripts", "benchmark", "external", "terminal-bench-2"),
95				filepath.Join(opts.workDir, "scripts", "benchmark", "external", "terminal-bench", "tasks"),
96			}
97			for _, c := range candidates {
98				if _, err := os.Stat(c); err == nil {
99					tasksDir = c
100					break
101				}
102			}
103		}
104		subsetPath := opts.subsetPath
105		if subsetPath == "" {
106			subsetPath = filepath.Join(opts.workDir, "scripts", "beadbench", "external", "termbench-subset.json")
107		}
108	
109		subset, err := loadTermbenchSubset(subsetPath)
110		if err != nil {
111			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: load subset %s: %v\n", benchCommandName(), subsetPath, err)
112			return 1
113		}
114	
115		// Build the agent service once; reuse across tasks.
116		cfg, err := agentConfig.Load(opts.workDir)
117		if err != nil {
118			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: load config: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
119			return 1
120		}
121		svc, err := fizeau.New(fizeau.ServiceOptions{
122			ServiceConfig: &configAdapter{cfg: cfg, workDir: opts.workDir},
123		})
124		if err != nil {
125			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: new service: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
126			return 1
127		}
128	
129		runID := fmt.Sprintf("termbench-%d", time.Now().Unix())
130		outBase := filepath.Join(opts.workDir, "benchmark-results", "termbench", runID)
131		if err := os.MkdirAll(outBase, 0o750); err != nil {
132			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: mkdir: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
133			return 1
134		}
135	
136		report := termbenchRunReport{
137			RunID:     runID,
138			StartedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
139			Subset:    subsetPath,
140			TasksDir:  tasksDir,
141			Harness:   opts.harness,
142			Model:     opts.model,
143		}
144	
145		maxTasks := opts.maxTasks
146		if maxTasks <= 0 || maxTasks > len(subset.Tasks) {
147			maxTasks = len(subset.Tasks)
148		}
149	
150		for i, entry := range subset.Tasks[:maxTasks] {
151			summary := termbenchTaskRunSummary{
152				TaskID:     entry.ID,
153				Category:   entry.Category,
154				Difficulty: entry.Difficulty,
155				Harness:    opts.harness,
156				Model:      opts.model,
157			}
158			taskOutDir := filepath.Join(outBase, entry.ID)
159			taskDir := filepath.Join(tasksDir, entry.ID)
160			if _, err := os.Stat(taskDir); err != nil {
161				summary.Status = "skipped"
162				summary.Error = fmt.Sprintf("task dir not found: %s (submodule not initialized?)", taskDir)
163				report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
164				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[%d/%d] %s: %s\n", i+1, maxTasks, entry.ID, summary.Error)
165				continue
166			}
167			task, err := termbench.LoadTask(taskDir)
168			if err != nil {
169				summary.Status = "error"
170				summary.Error = err.Error()
171				report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
172				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[%d/%d] %s: load task: %v\n", i+1, maxTasks, entry.ID, err)
173				continue
174			}
175			if err := os.MkdirAll(taskOutDir, 0o750); err != nil {
176				summary.Status = "error"
177				summary.Error = err.Error()
178				report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
179				continue
180			}
181			// For the Go-side dry-run we operate the agent against a fresh
182			// per-task tempdir. Real Harbor runs would mount the container
183			// workspace; here we just need a writable cwd for the fizeau.
184			workDir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "termbench-"+entry.ID+"-")
185			if err != nil {
186				summary.Status = "error"
187				summary.Error = err.Error()
188				report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
189				continue
190			}
191			defer os.RemoveAll(workDir)
192	
193			plan := termbench.BuildPlan(task, termbench.PlanOptions{
194				Harness:     opts.harness,
195				Provider:    opts.provider,
196				Model:       opts.model,
197				WorkDir:     workDir,
198				Permissions: opts.permissions,
199			})
200			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), plan.Timeout)
201			start := time.Now()
202			ch, err := svc.Execute(ctx, plan.Request)
203			if err != nil {
204				cancel()
205				summary.Status = "error"
206				summary.Error = err.Error()
207				summary.DurationMS = time.Since(start).Milliseconds()
208				report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
209				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[%d/%d] %s: execute: %v\n", i+1, maxTasks, entry.ID, err)
210				continue
211			}
212			traj := termbench.Capture(ch, termbench.CaptureOptions{
213				SessionID: runID + "/" + entry.ID,
214				TaskID:    entry.ID,
215				Agent: termbench.AgentInfo{
216					Name:      opts.harness,
217					Version:   "bench",
218					ModelName: opts.model,
219				},
220				StartedAt: start,
221			})
222			cancel()
223			if err := termbench.WriteHarnessOutput(taskOutDir, traj); err != nil {
224				summary.Status = "error"
225				summary.Error = err.Error()
226			} else {
227				summary.Status = "ran"
228				summary.Trajectory = filepath.Join(taskOutDir, "logs", "agent", "trajectory.json")
229			}
230			summary.ExitCode = traj.ExitCode
231			summary.DurationMS = traj.DurationMS
232			summary.InputTokens = traj.FinalMetrics.InputTokens
233			summary.OutputTokens = traj.FinalMetrics.OutputTokens
234			summary.CostUSD = traj.FinalMetrics.Cost
235	
236			// If the upstream verifier already produced a reward (e.g. a
237			// previous Harbor pass dropped it into the same dir), surface
238			// it. Absent reward stays nil so reporters can distinguish
239			// "not graded" from "graded as failed".
240			if g, gerr := termbench.ReadGraderResult(entry.ID, taskOutDir); gerr == nil {
241				r := g.Reward
242				summary.Reward = &r
243				summary.Status = "graded"
244			} else if !errors.Is(gerr, termbench.ErrNoVerifierOutput) {
245				summary.Error = strings.Join([]string{summary.Error, gerr.Error()}, "; ")
246			}
247	
248			report.Results = append(report.Results, summary)
249			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[%d/%d] %s: status=%s exit=%d duration=%dms\n",
250				i+1, maxTasks, entry.ID, summary.Status, summary.ExitCode, summary.DurationMS)
251		}
252	
253		if len(report.Notes) == 0 {
254			report.Notes = []string{
255				"Reward fields are populated only when an upstream Harbor verifier has written /logs/verifier/reward.txt into the per-task output directory.",
256				"To complete grading, run: scripts/benchmark/run_benchmark.sh after this command (Docker required).",
257			}
258		}
259	
260		reportPath := filepath.Join(outBase, "results.json")
261		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
262		if err != nil {
263			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: marshal report: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
264			return 1
265		}
266		if err := os.WriteFile(reportPath, data, 0o600); err != nil {
267			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s run --external=termbench: write report: %v\n", benchCommandName(), err)
268			return 1
269		}
270		fmt.Printf("termbench results: %s\n", reportPath)
271		return 0
272	}
273	
274	// externalRunOptions is the parsed set of flags consumed by external
275	// benchmark adapters.
276	type externalRunOptions struct {
277		workDir     string
278		subsetPath  string
279		tasksDir    string
280		harness     string
281		provider    string
282		model       string
283		permissions string
284		maxTasks    int
285	}

287	func loadTermbenchSubset(path string) (*termbenchSubset, error) {
288		data, err := os.ReadFile(path) // #nosec G304 -- path is operator-controlled flag
289		if err != nil {
290			return nil, err
291		}
292		var s termbenchSubset
293		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &s); err != nil {
294			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse subset: %w", err)
295		}
296		if len(s.Tasks) == 0 {
297			return nil, fmt.Errorf("subset has no tasks")
298		}
299		return &s, nil

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# run_terminalbench_2_1_sweep.sh — convenience wrapper for the TB-2.1 sweep runner.
#
# Usage:
#   ./scripts/benchmark/run_terminalbench_2_1_sweep.sh [flags]
#
# All flags are forwarded to `fiz-bench sweep`. Common flags:
#   --phase canary|local-qwen|sonnet-comparison|gpt-comparison|all
#   --dry-run          Print plan without launching Harbor
#   --out <dir>        Output directory (default: benchmark-results/sweep-<timestamp>)
#   --resume           Skip terminal cells (default: true)
#   --force-rerun      Rerun even terminal cells
#   --tasks-dir <dir>  Path to TB-2.1 tasks directory (enables Harbor grading)
#   --budget-usd <n>   Total sweep budget cap in USD
#   --per-run-budget-usd <n>  Per-run budget cap in USD
#   --matrix-jobs-managed <n> Concurrent cells for managed-provider lanes (default: 1)
#   --sweep-plan <file> Override sweep plan YAML (default: scripts/benchmark/terminalbench-2-1-sweep.yaml)
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - fiz-bench binary on PATH (go install ./cmd/bench or go build -o fiz-bench ./cmd/bench)
#   - OPENROUTER_API_KEY set for managed provider lanes
#   - Local model endpoints reachable for local lanes (vidar:1235, grendel:8000, etc.)
#
# Example — dry-run all phases:
#   ./scripts/benchmark/run_terminalbench_2_1_sweep.sh --dry-run
#
# Example — run canary phase with Harbor grading:
#   ./scripts/benchmark/run_terminalbench_2_1_sweep.sh \
#     --phase canary \
#     --tasks-dir /path/to/terminal-bench-2-1 \
#     --per-run-budget-usd 5.0
#
# Example — resume local-qwen phase from existing output:
#   ./scripts/benchmark/run_terminalbench_2_1_sweep.sh \
#     --phase local-qwen \
#     --out benchmark-results/sweep-20260507T120000Z \
#     --resume
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../.." && pwd)"

if ! command -v fiz-bench >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "error: fiz-bench not found on PATH" >&2
    echo "  Build it with: go build -o fiz-bench ./cmd/bench" >&2
    exit 1
fi

exec fiz-bench sweep \
    --work-dir "${REPO_ROOT}" \
    --sweep-plan "${REPO_ROOT}/scripts/benchmark/terminalbench-2-1-sweep.yaml" \
    "$@"
